descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自绘的热狗下方添了餐盘，洋葱碎全留在纸上的盘里。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s hot dog sketch has a plate beneath it to catch the drawn onion.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使饭后画的乳酪碗，浆果留着半圈浅红。
descriptions.en: The messenger drew the dairy bowl after eating, with half a berry-colored circle.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使折出的层层纸圈，展开时中心空着。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s nested paper rings open around an empty centre.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使剪的两条纸包带，一条端正，一条故意有点歪。
descriptions.en: Two straps cut from paper by the messenger, one neat and one deliberately crooked.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自制的弯纸带，只记录远远看水鸟的一段水纹。
descriptions.en: A curved strip made by the messenger recalls a wake watched from the path.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使做的翻卡，纸鸭从圆圈外面露头。
descriptions.en: On the messenger’s original flap card, a paper duck appears outside the rings.
